title: NIST WebBook: calcium dihydroxide is CaH2O2, molecular weight 74.093 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists calcium dihydroxide as CaH2O2, molecular weight 74.093 amu, CAS 1305-62-0.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for calcium dihydroxide, CAS Registry Number 1305-62-0, lists molecular formula CaH2O2 and molecular weight 74.093 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 73.96807028 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is not printed in the JSON-LD MolecularEntity. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
